com.datastax.oss.driver.api.testinfra.requirement

Annotation Type BackendRequirement


  • @Repeatable(value=BackendRequirements.class)
 @Retention(value=RUNTIME)
public @interface BackendRequirement
    Annotation for a Class or Method that defines a database backend Version requirement. If the type/version in use does not meet the requirement, the test is skipped.
